statement: Build a one-page, mobile-first website for Brew Lab, a specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, where visitors can see the menu with prices, opening hours and location, pre-order a coffee for pickup, learn about the beans and their farms, and understand the loyalty card.
audience: Local coffee drinkers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on phones, who want to check the menu, hours and location and order ahead for pickup.
standards: Warm and modern look: earthy coffee-toned palette, clean type, generous spacing
Mobile-first: usable at 360px width, tap targets at least 44px, no horizontal scroll
One file of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step (CDN libraries allowed)
Every fact the Requester has not supplied is shown as a visibly marked placeholder, never invented
Readable text contrast and semantic headings, with alt text on images
rules: Single page with sections reached by anchor navigation
Never invent prices, hours, address, phone numbers, farm names or any other fact not in the brief
Loyalty rule is exactly: buy 9, get the 10th free
done_when: The file is a single HTML document with inline or CDN CSS and JS and no build step
The page has a menu section listing items with a price shown for each (real or marked placeholder)
The page has an opening-hours section with every day of the week listed (real or marked placeholder)
The page has a where-to-find-us section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with an address and a map link or embed (address marked placeholder if unknown)

The page has a pre-order-for-pickup form where a visitor picks items and quantities, enters name, phone and pickup time, and gets an order summary on submit; the order destination is a marked placeholder
The page has a beans-and-farms section describing the beans and their farms (farm details marked placeholder if unknown)
The page has a loyalty-card explainer stating buy 9, get the 10th free
The file has a viewport meta tag and responsive CSS rules with a mobile layout
Every placeholder is visibly marked in the page text, and none is presented as fact
Navigation links to each section work as in-page anchors
open_inputs: Menu items and prices in INR
Phone, WhatsApp or email for contact
How pre-orders reach the shop (WhatsApp number, email or other) and whether payment is at pickup or online
Pickup time rules (earliest slot, lead time)
Bean names, roast details, and the farms and regions they come from
